title: Hello
description: Write a program that prints hello, world followed by a newline.
hint: Swift's print function writes text to the console.

title: Plurality
description: Implement a program that determines the winner of a plurality election.
hint: Keep track of each candidate's vote count. After all votes have been processed, find the candidate with the greatest number of votes.
pseudocode:
For each vote:
    Find the selected candidate
    Increase their vote count

Find the candidate with the most votes

Print the winner

title: Speller
description: Load words into an efficient data structure and use it to determine whether words are correctly spelled.
hint: A Swift Set can provide efficient membership testing.
pseudocode:
Load dictionary words

For every word in the text:
    Check whether the dictionary contains it

Report unknown words
